collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — HUMOR AND ABSURDITY (HUM-01 to HUM-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Slapstick, silly noises, puns, pranks with permission, ridiculous coincidences, a little funny magic and animals being absurd. Nobody is the butt of the joke: everyone keeps their dignity, and the comedy needs no victim.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: Two old friends laugh at a breadfruit joke neither can remember, and a child asks why: try to explain, or make up a new one.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Years ago, (subject) and (friend) shared a joke about a breadfruit. Neither of them can remember what the joke was. But whenever one of them says the word "breadfruit," both of them dissolve into helpless laughter. Today (child), a child who has seen this happen many times, finally asks them what's so funny about breadfruit.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: They try. They really try. "Well, there was a breadfruit," begins (subject), "and it..." "...and it..." says (friend), and they're gone again. (child) waits patiently, then gives up and wanders off. That evening (child) is heard saying "breadfruit" to a group of friends and laughing helplessly, with no idea why.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: (friend) makes one up on the spot. "Why did the breadfruit roll down the hill? Because it was on a roll." It's dreadful. (child) doesn't laugh even slightly. (subject) and (friend) laugh so hard they have to lie down on the ground. Now there are two breadfruit jokes, and they only know one of them.
